summary: First testing pass on Depth Route Dialer (Expo/React Native + FastAPI + MongoDB). Ran 41 backend pytest cases covering auth (login/register/logout/me + 401 paths) and all 16 authenticated mock-data endpoints — 41/41 PASSED. Ran Playwright mobile-viewport (390x844) UI tests via the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL preview: login pre-fill works, Sign In navigates to Dashboard with all expected testIDs (4 stat cards, 5 quick actions, 5 recent calls, 3 quick-stat cards, profile row). Bottom tabs (Dashboard/Dialer/Contacts/Call Logs/More) all navigate and render expected testIDs. Detail screens (voicemails, sms, recordings, sip-accounts, extensions, numbers, ivr, plans, billing, reports, notifications, profile, support) all load with non-empty content. Sidebar drawer opens via hamburger, all sidebar-item-* testIDs are present and navigate correctly; after adding a testID to the backdrop, backdrop-tap-to-close works. Logout from More clears session and returns to Login. No red-screen errors, no console errors. No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected in package.json.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider adding testID on Header's SIP pill container children if you plan to assert live SIP status text in future tests (currently header-sip-pill exists and is enough).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~578 lines with all mock endpoints inlined. Still under the 700-line threshold, but if more endpoints are added consider splitting mock data into /app/backend/mock_data/*.py modules.
CORS is set to allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for credentialed requests; harmless for the current Bearer-token flow but worth tightening.

google_session upserts session using Emergent's session_token as the primary key — good. Expiration is checked in get_current_user only when the value is a datetime; when Mongo returns a naive datetime it is correctly coerced to UTC.
user_public excludes password and _id explicitly — good.
Frontend correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (via src/api.ts) with no hardcoded URLs.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx (added testID="sidebar-backdrop" to Pressable so backdrop-tap-close can be tested)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Backend auto-seeds demo@depthroute.com/demo1234 on startup. One TEST_ user is registered per pytest run (left in DB — safe to purge with db.users.deleteMany({email:/^TEST_/})).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testIDs: login-card, login-email, login-password, login-submit-button. Hamburger: header-menu-button (not header-menu). Sidebar item keys: voicemails, sms, recordings, sip (NOT sip-accounts), extensions, numbers, ivr, plans, billing, reports, profile, notifications, support. Same keys for more-item-* on the More tab (i.e., more-item-sip, not more-item-sip-accounts). Sidebar backdrop testID is now sidebar-backdrop. Bottom tabs: tab-dashboard, tab-dialer, tab-contacts, tab-call-logs, tab-more. Backend base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Google OAuth cannot be end-to-end tested here; button visibility only is verified.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Only one small test-infrastructure gap fixed (added testID to sidebar backdrop Pressable).
